test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The length, breadth and height of a closed cuboidal box are 2.5 m, 2 m and 90 cm respectively. What will be the cost of the canvas required to completely cover this box, if the price of the canvas is ₹ 80 per square meter?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cuboidal box = 2.5 m

Breadth of the cuboidal box = 2 m

Height of the cuboidal box = 90 cm = 0.9 m

Cost of canvas per square meter = ₹ 80

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Total Cost = Surface Area × Cost per square meter

**Calculation:**

Surface Area of the box = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(2.5 × 2 + 2 × 0.9 + 0.9 × 2.5)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(5 + 1.8 + 2.25)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(9.05)

⇒ Surface Area = 18.1 m²

Total Cost = Surface Area × Cost per square meter

⇒ Total Cost = 18.1 × 80

⇒ Total Cost = 1,448

**The cost of the canvas required to completely cover the box is ₹ 1,448.**
